content:
We need to find template that when applied to given molecule (target) reproduces reaction: deprotection of TBS group, breaking O-Si bond, forming aliphatic hydroxyl. So forward reaction: protected alcohol (with TBS) -> free alcohol. In retrosynthesis, we need to break O-Si bond, i.e., remove TBS group. So we need template that removes TBS group. We need to return mapped_rxn and template_id.

We have target molecule SMILES: O[C@H]1C[C@@H](O[C@@H]([C@@H]1C)/C=C(CO)/C)C/C=C/C=C/C(O)=O

We need to search templates with functional_groups_broken: "t-butyldimethylsilyl" maybe? The functional groups list unknown. Could use search_template_catalog_by_criteria with functional_groups_broken = ["t-butyldimethylsilyl"] and functional_groups_formed = ["aliphatic hydroxyls"].

Let's try.
